About the job

AI Automation Engineer (Remote – UK)

Location: Fully Remote – United Kingdom

Salary: £55,000 – £80,000 per annum (DOE)

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About the Opportunity

One of our clients is looking for a highly skilled AI Automation Engineer to design, build, and deploy intelligent automation solutions across their business operations. This fully remote UK-based role is ideal for someone with strong experience in AI tools, workflow automation, APIs, and system integrations.

You’ll work at the intersection of AI, process improvement, and engineering — identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and implementing scalable automation solutions that drive efficiency and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement AI-driven automation workflows across business functions
  • Build and integrate systems using APIs and automation platforms
  • Develop and deploy LLM-based solutions (e.g., chatbots, internal tools, document automation)
  • Optimise processes using AI, RPA, and scripting solutions
  • Collaborate with product, operations, and engineering teams to identify automation opportunities
  • Ensure automation solutions are secure, scalable, and maintainable
  • Monitor performance and continuously improve automation pipelines
  • Document processes and technical configurations

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in automation engineering, AI development, or workflow automation
  • Strong programming skills (Python preferred; JavaScript beneficial)
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with RESTful services
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM platforms and prompt engineering
  • Experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, Power Automate, UiPath, etc.)
  • Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
  • Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment

Desirable (Not Essential)

  • Experience building AI-powered internal tools or SaaS integrations
  • Exposure to DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of data pipelines and basic ML concepts
  • Experience with vector databases or embeddings
  • Background in process optimisation or digital transformation

What’s on Offer

  • Fully remote UK-based role
  • Competitive salary (£55k–£80k DOE)
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and automation projects
  • High autonomy and innovation-driven culture
  • Career progression into Lead Automation Engineer / AI Architect
  • Flexible working environment
